source.custody: Retrieval pointer only; unresolved source wording conflict

target: Synthetic autonomous execution and stop/recovery laboratory
proposition: Shared-dependency control loss and operational recovery conditions may inform autonomous execution stop tests

dimensions.name: functional
dimensions.correspondence: Normal automatic and human control versus alternative actuation
dimensions.limitation: Physical steering differs from digital enforcement
dimensions.defeating_observation: Target override does not control specified effect

dimensions.name: causal
dimensions.correspondence: Common failed dependency disables two control paths
dimensions.defeating_observation: Target control remains available despite dependency loss

dimensions.name: dependency
dimensions.correspondence: Shared sensor vs shared control plane

dimensions.name: state
dimensions.correspondence: Actual rudder response vs actual committed effect
dimensions.defeating_observation: Reported stop differs from effect journal

dimensions.name: temporal
dimensions.correspondence: Emergency response deadline vs commit boundary
dimensions.limitation: Synthetic ticks, no physical timing claim

dimensions.name: authority
dimensions.limitation: Legal standing and real authentication untested

dimensions.name: observability
dimensions.correspondence: Independent indication vs separate effect journal
dimensions.defeating_observation: Observer fails or falsely reports actual effect

dimensions.name: recovery
dimensions.correspondence: Alternative steering vs bounded essential service
dimensions.limitation: No real rollback or control dynamics
dimensions.defeating_observation: Essential function lost or recovery overreaches

dimensions.name: completeness
dimensions.correspondence: Declared control paths vs modeled worker and bypass

dimensions.name: falsifiability
dimensions.correspondence: Fault injection and measured state transitions
dimensions.defeating_observation: Independent reproduction contradicts predicted scoped result

counterevidence: Shared emergency route failure with fail-closed gate: no modeled violation.
Cancellation without commit fence succeeds for single worker but fails on retry.
Blanket shutdown misses required essential service.
reopen: Independent maritime reconciliation, independently designed software tests, counterexample or missing dependency discovered
